Setup.Name: Change time zone
Setup.Description: Parses a log using the dissect parser and interprets the provided timestamp as a given time zone.
Setup.Manifest:
Processors:
  - Name: "Server logs"
    Description: "Collect all log messages from the server and interpret timestamp as timezone europe/berlin."
    Mqtt:
      Subscriptions:
        - Topic: "sensor/+/log"
    Otel:
      Attributes:
        - Key: Location
          Value: MainServerRoom
      Logs:
        - PayloadType: Json
          Transform: "DISSECT('%{otel_timestamp:DateTime[Europe/Berlin]} [%{otel_loglevel}] %{otel_message}')"
